_automaticRadius_info: If true, the teleport radius is automatically set to Cobblemon's pastureMaxWanderDistance minus radiusMargin. maxPastureRadius is used as a fallback if Cobblemon's config is unavailable. Default: true.
_radiusMargin_info: How many blocks are subtracted from Cobblemon's pastureMaxWanderDistance in automatic mode. Default: 4.
_maxPastureRadius_info: Manual teleport radius and fallback for automatic mode. Must be lower than Cobblemon's pastureMaxWanderDistance. Default: 28.
_useHorizontalDistanceOnly_info: If true, only horizontal (X/Z) distance is checked, ignoring height. Good for pastures near cliffs or multi-level farms. If false, full 3D sphere distance is used. Default: false.
_candidateTeleportAttempts_info: How many random positions around the pasture block are tried when searching for a safe landing spot (solid ground + clear headroom). Higher values reduce the chance of landing inside a block, at a tiny performance cost. Default: 24.
_fallbackYOffset_info: If no safe position is found after candidateTeleportAttempts tries, the Pokémon is placed this many blocks directly above the pasture block as a last resort. Default: 1.5.
_debugLogging_info: If true, nearby players see a chat message whenever a Pokémon is teleported back (e.g. 'Pikachu left tether box → (x, y, z)'). Default: false.
_serverLogging_info: If true, teleport events are written to the server log. Disable this if the log spam is unwanted. Default: false.
_preventTeleportFallDamage_info: If true, a Pokémon teleported back by TP-Pastures takes no fall damage from that teleport. Protection lasts until it lands. Default: true.
_invulnerablePasturedPokemon_info: If true, damage to Pokémon currently assigned to a Pasture Block is filtered using damageFilterMode and damageTypes. Default: true.
_damageFilterMode_info: BLACKLIST prevents the damage types listed in damageTypes. WHITELIST allows only the damage types listed in damageTypes. Use Minecraft damage type IDs such as minecraft:in_fire. Default: BLACKLIST.
_damageTypes_info: Damage type IDs used by damageFilterMode. The wildcard * matches every damage type. Default: ["*"] (all damage is prevented).
_clearHazardousStatesAfterTeleport_info: If true, fire, drowning and freezing states are cleared after TP-Pastures teleports a Pokémon. Default: true.
_teleportParticles_info: If true, portal particles are shown at the old and new position when a Pokémon is teleported. Default: false.
_teleportSounds_info: If true, an Enderman teleport sound is played at the old and new position when a Pokémon is teleported. Default: false.
